jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Be yourself at Protolabs   Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.  We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace.  So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply!  You can help make our company even better.  We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself.  We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.  
 Why Protolabs?   We are the leaders in digital manufacturing.  We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds.  We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do.  It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.  

 Join our team as a

 Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead!

 This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. 

 Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts  fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. 

 We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. 

The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. 
 What You Will Do: 
 Technical leadership & core development 

 Drive core development of transformative capabilities.

 Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives.

 Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management.

 Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases.

 Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases 

 Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner.

 Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups.

 Market observation & innovation 

 Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company.

 Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability.

 Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers.

 Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements.

 Cross-organisation delivery & architecture

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
jobs.description:
At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data. 
 About the role 

 Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. 

 We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. 
 What You'll Do 

 Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models . Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.

 Train at scale . Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real.

 Define what "good" means . Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy.

 Explore stronger priors . Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see.

 Land research in the product . Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there.

 Track the field . This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it.

 What we're looking for 

 Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience . You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break.

 A track record of models others relied on . We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here.

 Large-scale trainin g. Practical experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early.

 Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI.

 Research judgment . You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so.

 Clear communication with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike.

 Strong pluses 
 These are listed in order of how much they matter to us. 

 Feed-forward Gaussian prediction . Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. 

 Top-tier publications in feed-forward reconstruction . First-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. 

 Video diffusion models . Familiarity with diffusion or flow-matching video models, especially camera-conditioned generation. 

 Dynamic scenes . Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. 

 Real-world capture . Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. 

 Making big models fast, or open-source contributions to widely used reconstruction libraries.

 Why join Parallel Domain? 
 We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative cultu

jobs.title: Computer Vision and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Computer Vision and Machine Learning (CV/ML) Engineer to develop and deploy intelligent perception systems for our autonomous drone-in-a-box platform. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. As part of a small, technical team, you will own solutions across our software stack, taking algorithms and models from prototype to deployment. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.
 Responsibilities
 Design and develop a wide variety of computer vision and machine learning features for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications
 Train, fine-tune and evaluate deep learning models for tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, image retrieval/reidentification
 Optimize algorithms and models for edge devices (NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm Dragonwing), and integrate them into our image and video processing pipelines
 Monitor ML model performance in real-world deployments and set up workflows for continuous improvement (data collection, curation, labeling, retraining, evaluation)
 Evaluate and integrate large/vision language models for scene understanding, situational awareness, and hazard analysis, including prompt design, performance benchmarking, and production deployment
 Qualifications
 Degree in Computer Science, Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 Solid understanding of computer vision and machine learning fundamentals
 Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with experience developing production-grade software that powers CV/ML systems
 Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA
 Experience with end-to-end model development: from dataset curation, labeling strategies, active learning workflows to deployment and optimization for edge devices
 Excellent oral and written skills in English
 Work permit in Switzerland required
 Bonus Points
 Good understanding of 3D vision and robotics perception, along with hands-on experience with OpenCV and ROS/ROS2, is a strong plus
 Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm edge devices, and their CV/ML SDKs
 Experience with transformers, large/vision language models and prompt design for perception tasks
 Experience with complex GStreamer pipelines and custom plugin development
 100% · On-site

 In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI engineering, backend development, product development and cloud deployment, building production-ready AI systems that create real business value.

 As an AI Application Engineer, you design and build AI-powered applications and product features for enterprise clients.
 Your projects may include:
 Designing and developing AI applications, such as enterprise assistants, AI copilots, semantic search platforms and intelligent automation systems

 Building LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks

 Developing end-to-end AI products, integrating LLM APIs, enterprise data sources and backend services

 Designing scalable AI microservices and APIs to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms

 Implementing vector search, embeddings pipelines and knowledge retrieval systems

 Rapidly prototyping AI product features and proof-of-concepts and evolving them into production systems

 Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers and enterprise customers to develop impactful AI solutions

 Ensuring reliable, scalable and observable AI services through CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and containerized deployments

 Benefits

 Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams including AI engineers, software developers and data scientists across industries such as Banking, Insurance, Automotive and Retail

 A very active social program including paid training, conferences, communities of practice, hackathons and Reply XChange

 Monetary Benefits include: Mobility package, Gym subsidy & WellPass, Insurance & Pension Scheme, Corporate Savings Plan, KiTa and Childcare Allowance

 Flexible work arrangement between home office, EU-wide workation options, on site office-work in our downtown Munich office with access to Stammstrecke, and client on site visits

 Requirements 
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a comparable technical field

 Convincing communication and presentation skills in German and English in order to participate in workshops of both languages

 Strong programming skills in Python and modern backend frameworks

 Experience building applications using AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies

 Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases

 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP

 Engaging directly with enterprise clients to understand their business challenges and identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven solutions
